collection_gaps: SUBSTITUTION: exact 'SnugRide 35 Lite LX' (4-35 lb, legacy model 2106696) is no longer sold on gracobaby.com; collected the current renamed variant 'SnugRide Lite LX' (4-30 lb, model 2110186, Studio) which shares the same product imagery. The weight-rating difference (30 vs 35 lb) is material for a child-restraint domain.
Legacy 4-35 lb '35 Lite LX' manual exists only on third-party ManualsLib (manualslib.com/manual/1858019); not downloaded per official-sources-only rule.
No separate quick-start or base-only installation PDF is published on the PDP — only the full EN/ES instruction manuals (base install is covered inside them).
FAA/aircraft certification not stated on the product page and not found via crude text extraction of the manual PDF; unverified.
Official image set lacks a clean studio shot of the carrier alone (without base), a true rear view, and intermediate carry-handle positions; only handle-up is shown.
No official Graco-channel video specifically showing the one-step stroller click-in for this seat was found after 3 search approaches.
Compatibility chart per-cell check/dash markers are graphics; row-level compatibility transcribed to specs.md but per-cell marks must be read from the PDF.
